item.title: Schuylkill weather ups and downs
item.description: Given more than a foot of snow, icy winds and temperatures in the single digits, it’s hard to think of January as anything but severe. But in 1931, a freak warm spell struck the region in January. The mercury peaked so high that buds began to appear on trees. The warm spell brought a thunderstorm on Feb. 25. item.title: Starwatch: Jupiter and great winter constellations dominate February skies
item.description: February stargazing is so special in Pottsville. Sure it’s cold but the extra special celestial jewels make it worth bundling up for. If you’re not already in the darker countryside, try to get out there. But even with light polluted skies, I know you’ll like what you see. The first week or so of February will be a bit messed up because of bright moonlight. This weekend we kick off with a full moon. February full moons have several nicknames. item.title: H.S. WRESTLING: Tri-Valley finishes second at District 11 duals, punches ticket to State Duals
item.description: The Tri-Valley Bulldogs, a season ago, were eliminated in the quarterfinals of the District 11 duals by Saucon Valley 59-18. One year later, the Bulldogs were once again defeated by the Panthers, but this time, it was in the District 11 finals. It’s the Bulldogs’ best District 11 dual finish since 2015.
